state.request: Fill the gaps in the MCP edits; Jev and Laya review what is built.
state.design_decided: ObjectField width, height (finite, not negative; rect, ellipse, image, text only) and zIndex (drawing kinds only); setBlendMode, setAnchor, setEffects (replace the list, validate_effects), setShapePath (path and every subpath); createShape optional compoundPaths. Left out by name: layerId (engine refuses, 3.16), 2D material slots (11.50), 3D fields (11.48).
tests_run: contracts unit tests: refusals by name for kinds that draw nothing, invalid values, no-ops, restore on refusal; compound create and replace with the box following every subpath.

shipped gx-editor-mcp binary: one scenes.edit batch sets every new field and edit; a second process reads them back; preflight passes; seven bad edits refused by name with the store unchanged; a misspelt effect parameter refused naming it; tools/list schema accepts each new edit.

CPU reference render of a scene authored only by these edits: width 300 lit, raised red on top, green multiplied over red is black, both compound subpaths lit and nothing between, the replaced path filled, one stop of exposure 64 to 90, the anchor rotates about the centre.

refusals_by_name.instructions: Does every new edit refuse an unknown object, an inapplicable kind, an invalid value and a no-op by name, leaving the scene unchanged?

one_rule.instructions: Do the new edits reuse the existing drawability check and validators rather than a second copy of the rules?

shape_box_correct.instructions: Is it right that width and height are not settable on a shape (its box follows its path) and that setShapePath sets the box from every subpath?

leaving_out_right.instructions: Is leaving layerId, 2D material slots and the 3D fields without an edit, named, the right call while the engine refuses them?

criteria.no_gpu_render_test: The render check is on the CPU reference; the GPU path is covered by 3.20 and 3.22 evidence only.
criteria.zindex_group: zIndex on a group is refused though a group could order its children.
criteria.fill_rule_no_edit: A compound shape has no edit for its fill rule.
